question: begin{aligned} &(sec emptyset-tan emptyset)²(1+sin emptyset)² div cos ² emptyset=? \ end{aligned}
solution:
**Given:**

The given expression = (sec θ - tan θ)² (1 + sin θ)² ÷ cos² θ

**Formula used:**

1 - sin2 θ = cos2 θ

(a + b) (a - b) = a² - b²

**Calculation:**

(sec θ - tan θ)2 (1 + sin θ)2 ÷ cos2 θ

= [(1/cos θ) - (sin θ/cos θ)]2 (1 + sin θ)2 ÷ cos2 θ

= (frac{(1-sin θ)²)/(cos² θ)(1+sin θ)²}{cos² θ}

= (1 - sin θ)2 (1 + sin θ)2/cos⁴ θ

= [(1 - sin θ) (1 + sin θ)]2/cos4 θ

= (1 - sin² θ)²/cos4 θ

= (cos2 θ)2/cos4 θ

= cos4 θ/cos4 θ

= 1

**∴ The value of the given expression is 1**
